(a) x=x¹ (power 1), x·x=x² (power 2), x·x·x=x³ (power 3). One mark per row.
(b) Correct line, upward parabola and increasing cubic through the origin. One mark per graph.
(c) y=x is linear; y=x² and y=x³ are nonlinear. One mark for all three correct.
(d) After simplification, y=ax+b is linear (2); higher powers of x such as x² and x³ are nonlinear (1).
